entry.title: A turn in washing face and body
entry.summary: Davies includes cleaning the face and washing the body among the care activities an older toddler can join. Her chart describes growing participation with help, within care shared with an adult.
entry.cue: Your child wants to join a movement you are making during washing.
detail: The 18-month-to-3-year chart names face cleaning and body washing. For the body-washing example, Davies mentions a small travel-size soap bottle to reduce waste; she does not supply a bathing procedure in that list.
Her wider care discussion treats washing as time for communication and respectful touch. Talk about what is happening and listen to the child’s response, including gestures or sounds.
The child’s turn can be only part of the care. Davies keeps gentle adult assistance and a brief explanation alongside necessary care; participation does not mean managing the whole routine alone.
